gemini: the sandbox (tools.sandbox) is a default, not a lock: the --sandbox flag and GEMINI_SANDBOX take precedence over the system settings file, and any SANDBOX environment variable skips it; the default Seatbelt profile (permissive-open) does not restrict network access
gemini: the sandbox is not rendered on windows: it needs Docker or Podman there; set GEMINI_SANDBOX=docker|podman on the device
gemini: cannot self-enforce version; halod enforces
gemini: ring/release request headers are not supported
gemini-cli: no gateway configured; traffic is not routed through Halos
